notes.title: Up n Smoke - Demo (v0172)
notes.content:
Feedback was taken onboard and patched. New Features and concepts added to the Demo. The demo has extended play mechanics too.

[h2]Changelog v0172[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fullscreen/Window mode is now available in the options
[*] Quest to attain rank 3 will now correctly show complete, once you achieve rank 3 or higher
[*] Basil 2nd pot will now show pricing for the second purchase
[*] Basil will now show a helper note once you have max Basil pots
[*] Map Icons should now be clearer with a backlight fog
[*] Map Markers are a little less 'loud' and distracting
[*] QuestIcon are now easier to spot on the map with a little hover effect
[*] Updated Icon look for Map Markers; less eyeball-like and a little bit more subtle.
[*] All Upgrades/unlockables now pulse so they are more obvious to see int he scene.
[*] Fix - Fullscreen was toggling Silent Audio
[*] New Feature fix - notice me behavior wasn't applied correctly to all upgrades
[*] Cheese quest now should trigger on 10 (rather than 11) (Post Demo preview content) 
[*] Seed required notice on Basil pot 1 no longer hangs around when you have enough seeds
[*] Auto Seeding and harvesting switches are now working for Tomatoes
[*] AutoSeedBuyer now correctly charges for 10 seeds each cycle
[*] ShadyDealer has a voice(TXT) and requires trust now.
[*] Splashscreen now defaults fullscreen. Loading a game will resume your preference.
[/list]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464274/e14aadff0c3adbafede7e64d07568c3a30179c90.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464274/e14aadff0c3adbafede7e64d07568c3a30179c90.gif[/img][/url]

I have a feature request list I am still working on, watch this space for more updates - thank you for your patience <3

-T2

notes.title: Up n Smoke - Demo (v0171)
notes.content:
A huge issue was related to Saving and loading once I had converted to Steam's platform.
Some other fixes included and a hotfix slid in to handle a per OS download (saves 60% superfluous files being downloaded for other OS versions)

**Changelog v0171**
[list]
[*] Autosave now updates on manual saves
[*] Splash load will now load AutoSave (which will align with manual saves too - see above)
[*] Fixed Load on menu interface - Loading on Steam's platform was not loading variables at all.
[*] Perk Tree (WIP) now displays close more clearly
[*] NarrativeIcon will now open and close the narrative text window
[*] Exit now working on Steam platform (using Webview2)
[*] Default to fullscreen (after Splash selection)
[*] NEW button disabled while variables are not resetting (restart app to play a new game)
[*] Save/SaveExit now auto close the menu
[*] Splash Load not signaling close app save state
[*] HOTFIX - Disappearing background objects
[*] Optimizing download - Steam SDK handling OS better (Smaller DL per OS)
[*] New Steam Image work - Capsules and such now has UnS imagery 
[/list]

I have a bug list I am still working on, watch this space for more updates - thank you for your patience <3

-T2
